title: Édouard Mendy becomes patron of Senegal school that inspired charity project
summary_full: Edouard Mendy has taken on the role of patron for ADE School in Senegal, demonstrating his dedication to improving educational opportunities. The Yakar Project, which reflects Mendy's previous visit in 2015, aims to bolster community engagement and access to learning. By launching a digital learning hub at Yakar School, students now enjoy tablets and computers.
